mapper.select: SELECT id AS depositId, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, created_at AS depositedAt FROM piggy_bank_histories WHERE piggy_bank_id = #{piggyBankId} AND history_type = 'DEPOSIT' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO piggy_bank_histories (piggy_bank_id, history_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, trace_id, created_at) VALUES (#{piggyBankId}, 'DEPOSIT', #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{traceId}, NOW())
